baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive verb and its cognate object, يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا, enact a real reckoning, while يَسِيرًا qualifies that reckoning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Counting and reckoning are coupled to an opening made ready after difficulty, so the process remains substantive but its resistance is lowered.

activation_trace.role: The counting sense supplies an actual audit and makes the doubled verb-object construction procedural rather than vague.
Ready opening after difficulty supplies leniency as reduced friction within that audit.

changed_reading.after: He will undergo a real reckoning whose course is opened and made easy, not an account that has simply vanished.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَسِيرًا can qualify the magnitude or duration of the cognate noun حِسَابًا, not only its emotional difficulty.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tally remains genuine, but the small-amount branch construes ease quantitatively: few items, short duration, or limited burden.

activation_trace.role: Ordered counting supplies the measurable object whose extent can be reduced.
Smallness supplies a bounded quantity or duration rather than merely a gentle manner.

changed_reading.before: The account is easy because it is handled gently.
changed_reading.after: The account may be easy because it is little or brief: a bounded reckoning rather than exhaustive itemization.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ح س ب root can activate enoughness inside the reckoning construction, while ي س ر can contribute ample means.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of only reducing severity, the phrase can depict a settlement that is sufficient and positively resourced: enough is established without extracting everything possible.

activation_trace.role: Enoughness turns the account into a sufficient disposition rather than an endlessly expanding demand.
Prosperity and means make ease an affirmative sufficiency, not only the absence of hardship.

changed_reading.before: An easier version of an otherwise exacting audit is performed.
changed_reading.after: A sufficient settlement is reached with ample room: the account asks what is enough, not how much can be exacted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُحَاسَبُ can be heard through accountable supervision, and يَسِيرًا through pliant, quickly following movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reckoning becomes a well-managed review in which the subject moves without obstruction through each required step.

activation_trace.role: Accountable management supplies oversight, practical examination, and orderly disposition.
Light, compliant movement supplies the low-resistance manner in which the managed review proceeds.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes arithmetic performed with mercy.
changed_reading.after: The verse can describe an orderly, accountable review through which the person is conducted without resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first scene places an overhead enclosure into rupture and opening. That sequence makes the focus ease dynamic: the account is an opened passage through a world whose former enclosure no longer holds.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning supplies the ordered passage that must still be traversed.
Ready opening makes ease a newly available route after obstruction.
The enclosing height supplies the spatial boundary that had covered the scene.
Rupture that opens supplies the transition from enclosure to passability.

structural_cues: The opening rupture is the first event in the context window.
The focus adjective itself carries an after-difficulty opening image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an overhead enclosure, its opening rupture, and focus ease as ready opening. I infer that the same opening dynamic shapes passage through the account. A live alternative is that the rupture only establishes the cosmic scene and does not specify the account's manner.

changed_reading.after: The account is a navigable opening after rupture: judgment remains, but a way through it has been made available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated listening, formative governance, and exact fitting activate a congruence model. The account is easy when person, record, and rightful due meet their proper place without resistant mismatch.

activation_trace.role: Accountable management supplies the process that checks and places what is under review.
Pliant following supplies ease as compliance rather than mere softness.
Attentive reception and acceptance supply the low-resistance posture.
Repair, nurture, and completion make governance formative rather than merely punitive.
A right that fits its joint or vessel supplies exact congruence as the review's goal.

structural_cues: The listening-and-fitting formula recurs at 84:2 and 84:5.
Its repetition frames the human approach and book sequence that lead to 84:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accepted hearing, formative governance, exact fit, and pliant movement. I infer that congruence causes the account to proceed easily. A live alternative is that cosmic compliance contrasts with human accounting rather than modeling it.

changed_reading.before: Ease is a reduction in scrutiny.
changed_reading.after: Ease is absence of mismatch: a truthful record fits its due and can be settled without contest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ground is drawn out, casts out its contents, and becomes clear of liability. This turns accounting into evidentiary unloading: what was interior is externalized, connected, and released for inspection.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and testing information supplies the evidentiary function of the account.
Opening after obstruction supplies the ease produced when evidence is no longer concealed.
Lengthening until connection supplies a spread-out, inspectable evidentiary field.
Casting outward supplies the movement of hidden contents into view.
Release from liability supplies the clearing that follows complete unloading.

structural_cues: 84:3 expands the holding surface; 84:4 ejects what it held and declares it empty.
The focus follows the human's meeting and receipt of a record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extension, casting out, clearance from liability, and an information-testing focus branch. I infer that externalization makes the account easy by removing evidentiary friction. A live alternative is that the earth's unloading concerns resurrection material only, not the later personal record.

changed_reading.before: The favorable person receives a lighter audit.
changed_reading.after: The favorable account is easy because its contents unload into an open, connected field and leave no hidden liability to excavate.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mark branch, the scratches of toil, and the written record converge on legibility. The account can be easy because the life already bears readable traces rather than requiring a separate reconstruction.

activation_trace.role: Testing what information is present supplies the act of reading traces.
Separated lines and bodily marks supply the focus-side surface on which evidence can appear.
The split-root visible mark supplies an exploratory sign that makes a condition recognizable.
A scratch or bite trace makes arduous striving leave material evidence.
Ordered letters and the written object consolidate those traces as a readable record.

structural_cues: كَادِحٌ and كَدْحًا repeat the toil root before the book is handed over.
The focus itself offers bodily-line and information-testing branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split-root mark, scratched toil, writing, bodily lines, and information testing. I infer that lived toil inscribes its own evidence and thereby shortens reconstruction. A live alternative is that the mark mapping and bodily-line branch are only remote lexical echoes, while the book alone carries the record.

changed_reading.before: An external ledger is consulted to total the person's deeds.
changed_reading.after: The person's toil may already be self-inscribing; the easy account reads visible traces that life and book jointly bear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The record is given, carries an established judgment, and arrives in the hand of strength and right. The account therefore functions as ratification and transfer of an already coherent disposition, not open-ended investigation.

activation_trace.role: Formal reckoning supplies the documentary settlement being ratified.
Readiness supplies an unobstructed transfer and recognition of the record.
Giving supplies the completed transfer of the document to its bearer.
An inscription that establishes judgment supplies the record's already binding force.
The right hand as strength and right supplies authorized, favorable receipt.

structural_cues: The handed book immediately precedes the focus account.
The passive forms make both receipt and accounting happen to the same person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a transferred book, a binding inscription, right-hand authority, and immediate reckoning. I infer that documentary coherence allows ratification rather than adversarial inquiry. A live alternative is that the book merely announces the result while a separate full audit still occurs.

changed_reading.before: The person first receives evidence and is then independently investigated.
changed_reading.after: Receipt and account form one documentary settlement: the coherent record is handed over and promptly ratified.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel is reversal toward a community of belonging with inward joy. Ease thus describes a threshold function: a sufficient account releases the person into restored relation.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency makes the account a completed settlement capable of releasing the person onward.
Ready opening supplies the account's threshold into the next relation.
Turning back and arriving supply movement away from review toward return.
Nearness and belonging supply the social destination opened by settlement.
Inward joy and ease supply the affective confirmation that the passage has completed.

structural_cues: 84:9 is grammatically coordinated as the direct sequel to 84:8.
Return, belonging, and joy form a causal-looking sequence after settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sufficient focus branch followed immediately by return, belonging, and joy. I infer that settlement enables reintegration. A live alternative is simple chronology: joy follows the verdict without defining what made the account easy.

changed_reading.before: The account is an endpoint whose severity is reduced.
changed_reading.after: The account is a release threshold: once sufficiently settled, it opens return to belonging and inward joy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrasting record is placed behind the back, hidden from appearance, and followed by blockage and ruin. This sharpens the favorable account as a transparent, faceable relation to the record; concealment turns opening into obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Information testing supplies the inquiry that either meets an available record or confronts concealment.
Opening supplies the favorable path whose inverse is blockage.
The written object supplies the same class of evidence as in the favorable sequence.
Hiding something behind visibility supplies active concealment of the record.
Turning backs supplies relational refusal to face what the record shows.
Restraint and blockage supply the consequence opposite to an opened account.

structural_cues: The two recipients receive the same kind of book but in opposed bodily orientations.
The second sequence answers easy opening with a call of ruin and blocked movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a written record, concealment behind the back, bodily refusal, and blockage. I infer that openness to evidence helps make the favorable account easy, while concealment obstructs it. A live alternative is that orientation only marks the verdict already reached and does not cause procedural difference.

changed_reading.before: Ease is bestowed independently of the recipient's posture toward evidence.
changed_reading.after: Ease is relational transparency: a faceable record can be settled, whereas putting it behind the self converts disclosure into blockage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages a human forecast that there will be no return against a seeing that penetrates it. The focus root's own split between supposition and actual reckoning makes the account a counter-calculation that corrects a governing false premise.

activation_trace.role: Mental supposition supplies the person's provisional self-reckoning.
Actual reckoning supplies the corrective determination that displaces supposition.
Doubtful imagining supplies the unstable premise that no return will occur.
Return and diminution supply precisely what the private forecast excludes.
Interior discernment supplies the superior evidence that overturns self-supposition.

structural_cues: The claim of no return is immediately reversed by بَلَى.
The focus root independently houses both supposition and determinate counting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a false forecast, denied return, interior discernment, and two focus branches of the same root. I infer that judgment counter-reckons the subject's own model. A live alternative is that 84:14 characterizes only the adverse recipient and does not alter the favorable account in 84:8.

changed_reading.before: The account catalogs many separate acts.
changed_reading.after: The account can expose and correct one foundational miscalculation about return, replacing private supposition with an evidence-grounded reckoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Scattered contents are gathered into completion and then traversed layer over layer, state after state. The account may be easy because dispersed particulars are compressed into a coherent total and processed through stable stages.

activation_trace.role: Ordered calculation supplies the coherent total formed from gathered particulars.
Smallness supplies compression from many particulars to a bounded account.
Gathering dispersed things supplies aggregation into one holding total.
Completion and even order supply coherence to the aggregate.
One thing mounted over another supplies the architecture of staged review.
State after state supplies temporal traversal rather than one undifferentiated ordeal.

structural_cues: 84:17 gathers, 84:18 completes, and 84:19 traverses successive layers.
The focus repeats the reckoning root before giving it a bounded qualifier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, completed order, superposition, successive states, and bounded focus ease. I infer compression and staged processing as the arrow from multiplicity to ease. A live alternative is that these images describe cosmic time only and do not model accounting architecture.

changed_reading.before: Every deed is separately itemized in one long procedure.
changed_reading.after: Dispersed particulars may be gathered into a coherent total and crossed in ordered stages, making the account bounded without making it empty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence presents recitation and displays whether it produces trusting assent and embodied lowering or concealment and denial. Accounting becomes a direct response test: the offered sign and the body's answer expose orientation with little diagnostic ambiguity.

activation_trace.role: Testing what someone holds supplies a diagnostic rather than merely additive account.
Pliant following supplies the responsive movement that makes the diagnostic clear.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward positive response under test.
Recitation supplies the presented event to which a response becomes observable.
Lowering and yielding supply the embodied response whose absence is conspicuous.
Covering truth supplies the obstructive alternative to open assent.
Assigning falsehood supplies the explicit negative verdict emitted by that obstruction.

structural_cues: 84:20 asks about non-assent; 84:21 supplies recitation and non-prostration; 84:22 names concealment and denial.
The chain moves from inward trust to bodily response to verbal rejection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a presented recitation, absent assent, absent lowering, concealment, denial, and a focus information-test branch. I infer that this response chain functions as diagnostic evidence in the account. A live alternative is that the later verses exhort independently and do not describe how 84:8 is conducted.

changed_reading.before: Ease means fewer historical acts are counted.
changed_reading.after: Ease can mean diagnostic directness: presentation and response disclose the person's orientation without a sprawling evidentiary search.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context joins complete knowing to what people gather inside heart or container. The account therefore need not discover unknown facts; it opens and discloses contents already known, which explains ease without trivializing truth.

activation_trace.role: Information seeking supplies the ordinary fact-finding model that context now revises.
Opening supplies disclosure of a container whose contents are already accessible to knowledge.
The thing's disclosure to the knower supplies prior epistemic access.
Gathering meaning in the heart supplies the interior content being held.
A containing vessel supplies the spatial model for disclosure during account.

structural_cues: Knowledge grammatically precedes what is inwardly gathered in 84:23.
The focus's information-testing branch is therefore placed under prior knowledge, not ignorance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior knowing, inward gathering, containment, information testing, and opening. I infer that the account manifests known contents rather than discovering them. A live alternative is that 84:23 concerns concealed rejection only, while the favorable account uses a different procedure.

changed_reading.before: Accounting is an investigation undertaken to learn what happened.
changed_reading.after: Accounting is disclosure to the bearer of contents already fully known; its ease lies in manifestation, not evidentiary uncertainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Trusting assent and fitting action culminate in compensation whose extension is not cut down. This activates the sufficient-settlement baseline: the easy account is the hinge by which fitting action is settled into durable recompense.

activation_trace.role: Enoughness supplies settlement without endless extraction.
Ample means supply the positive abundance into which settlement opens.
Settled inward trust supplies the subject-position of the favorable settlement.
Intentional action supplies what is carried into recompense.
Fitness and suitability supply congruence between action and favorable outcome.
Compensation for work supplies the settlement's outward result.
Cutting and diminishing supply what the negated final expression excludes from recompense.

structural_cues: The final exception links assent, fitting action, compensation, and explicit non-cessation.
The sequence answers the focus's bounded procedure with an unbounded favorable result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trust, intentional fitting action, compensation, non-cutting, and focus sufficiency and means. I infer that the account is the settlement link converting action into durable recompense. A live alternative is that the final reward follows independently and does not explain the manner of 84:8.

changed_reading.before: The favorable account merely inflicts less burden.
changed_reading.after: The favorable account is sufficient settlement into abundance: a bounded procedure opens onto compensation that is not cut down.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus adjective's lots-and-divided-camel branch is distant from ordinary 'easy.' It remains anchored in يَسِيرًا and is independently activated by contextual division and measure; downstream prose should call it an allocation analogy and must not imply that judgment is random gambling.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reckoning root supplies counting, while the qualifier's remote lots branch supplies apportionment into shares.

activation_trace.role: Counting supplies ordered determination of an allotment.
Lots and division into shares supply the strange but focus-anchored allocation image.
Separating a share from a whole supplies deliberate apportionment.
A fixed measure supplies quantity and removes any need to infer chance.

changed_reading.after: The account may also allot a measured share from a gathered whole; 'easy' faintly activates division, while context converts chance-like lots into ordered measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because cushioning is a rare branch of ح س ب and not the construction's normal sense. It remains doubly anchored in the focus and gains motion from riding successive layers; downstream prose should present it only as a tactile analogy for supported passage, never as a lexical replacement for reckoning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare cushion branch of ح س ب and the light-motion branch of ي س ر coexist inside the two lexical anchors of the verse.

activation_trace.role: A small cushion or prop supplies material support under the person being conducted.
Light, compliant movement supplies the felt effect of that support.
Riding on a carried back supplies traversal by support rather than unaided strain.
Successive layers supply the terrain through which supported passage moves.

changed_reading.before: Ease is an abstract reduction of severity.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the person is propped and carried lightly through successive stages of a still-real account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates diseased or mottled skin and bodily-line branches far from ordinary accounting. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by stored interior content meeting an exposed surface; downstream prose should render only a surface-legibility metaphor and avoid claiming literal bodily pathology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The account root can mark a mottled bodily surface, while the qualifier can evoke separated bodily lines; together they offer an inspectable-surface analogy.

activation_trace.role: A visibly altered or mottled surface supplies the exterior on which condition appears.
Separate bodily lines or marks supply a readable pattern on that exterior.
Meaning gathered in the heart supplies the interior condition seeking manifestation.
The exposed skin or surface supplies the boundary where inward condition becomes outwardly legible.

changed_reading.before: Accounting reads only a detached written ledger.
changed_reading.after: As a contained surface metaphor, accounting reads how gathered interior content has become marked and legible on the bearer.

strongest_changes: The account shifts from fact-finding to disclosure: contents already known are opened rather than discovered.
The earth's unloading and the handed book make ease evidentiary transparency and documentary ratification.
The immediate return to belonging makes the account a release threshold, while the behind-the-back contrast makes concealment its blocking inverse.
The final uncut recompense strengthens a sufficient-settlement reading in which a bounded account opens onto durable abundance.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled reckoning root and the unusually rich branches of يَسِيرًا supported several coexisting mechanisms: lenient procedure, brief quantity, sufficient settlement, compliant fit, gathered compression, trace-reading, and direct response testing. Context did not collapse these into one verdict; it repeatedly changed what 'easy' could causally mean.
remaining_uncertainties: The mark, bodily-line, cushion, and lots readings are branch-distant analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.
Several later contrasts may explain only the adverse recipient rather than the procedure of the favorable account.
The text leaves open whether ease arises from the record's contents, the recipient's posture, the administrator's manner, or several of these at once.
